# API Tennis

> > Premium RESTful API providing real-time tennis data, statistics, and fixtures for ATP and WTA tournaments with JSON responses.

API Tennis delivers comprehensive tennis data feeds including live match statistics, player information, tournament schedules, and historical data. The service supports standard REST API integration with examples in PHP, cURL, and other languages for developers building tennis-related applications.

## Key Topics

- Tennis API
- ATP
- WTA
- RESTful API
- JSON
- Real-time data
